BackstoryDef.title: foal of the mountain winds
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among mountain air currents and learned to glide at an early age. Flying came as naturally to [PAWN_pronoun] as walking.

BackstoryDef.title: cloud-farm helper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped [PAWN_possessive] family on their cloud farm, carrying light tools, watching storm clouds, and flying short routes.

BackstoryDef.title: rooftop racer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took part in dangerous races between rooftops and towers. Quick starts came easily to [PAWN_objective], but long flights left [PAWN_objective] exhausted.

BackstoryDef.title: survivor of a fall
BackstoryDef.description: After a severe fall, [PAWN_nameDef] feared heights for a long time. The fear eventually faded, but [PAWN_possessive] cautious flying habits remained.

BackstoryDef.title: former Wonderbolt
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] completed elite flight training and performed as part of a famous aerial team. Even after leaving, [PAWN_pronoun] retained [PAWN_possessive] speed and flying technique.

BackstoryDef.title: air-mail courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years delivering mail between remote settlements. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to pace [PAWN_possessive] strength and keep moving.

BackstoryDef.title: crash rescuer
BackstoryDef.description: After an accident, [PAWN_nameDef] helped search for survivors and evacuate the injured. Since then, [PAWN_pronoun] has chosen reliable routes and conserved [PAWN_possessive] strength.

BackstoryDef.title: former aerial scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a scout, covering long distances while watching roads and camps from above.

BackstoryDef.title: flight-school instructor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] taught young flyers to control their breathing, pace their strength, and avoid needless risks.

BackstoryDef.title: cloud-show performer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performed in aerial shows, making sharp turns and daring stunts before the crowds.

BackstoryDef.title: storm courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] delivered cargo through bad weather. [PAWN_possessive] flight became fast and enduring, though recovery takes longer.
